name: SimplePost
description: Draft, preview, schedule and publish social posts using your connected SimplePost accounts.
restrictions: Requires a SimplePost account with an active trial or subscription and user-connected supported social destinations.
Read-only connections cannot validate supplied content, import or fit media, save drafts, publish, schedule, edit or discard posts.
Connecting the account does not approve individual writes. Sensitive writes require approval for every invocation in Muse.
Connecting or disconnecting social accounts and editing or deleting already-published social content are not MCP capabilities.

Workspace/editor tools require the PLUGIN_EXTENSIONS entitlement; image fitting requires IMAGE_FITTING. Muse support for MCP Apps UI is unverified; core workflows have text and structured-data outputs.
No Meta model API key, Muse Code installation, personal-agent skill import or new social provider is required.
This is an internal review kit, not a Meta manifest. Publication and portal-specific fields remain subject to Meta review.
